verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a broad server-side REST API with SDKs, an OpenAPI spec, campaign and event creation, webhooks, and an official MCP server. Its llms.txt claims the product is accessible headlessly, so people and agents can read, write and act on data outside the interface. However, nothing in the evidence asserts or shows full UI parity: flows, the drag-and-drop editors, segmentation, reports and the AI features (Composer, Customer Agent) are described as UI capabilities with no API equivalents shown. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of flows, segments, templates/editor and reporting, independent hands-on corroboration of headless completeness.
